coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 CLEFIA 这一种 128 位轻量级分组密码：128/192/256 位密钥、18/22/26 轮、4 分支广义 Feistel、F0/F1、S0/S1、M0/M1、Sigma、CON 常量、128/192/256 位密钥调度、RFC 6114 附录 A 的三组向量和附录 B 的中间值；不把 PRESENT、LEA、AES、Camellia、ISO/IEC 29192-2 整体或工作模式并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the CLEFIA 128-bit lightweight block cipher: 128/192/256-bit keys, 18/22/26 rounds, the 4-branch generalized Feistel network, F0/F1, S0/S1, M0/M1, Sigma, the CON constants, the 128/192/256-bit key schedules, the three Appendix A vectors and the Appendix B intermediates. It does not absorb PRESENT, LEA, AES, Camellia, ISO/IEC 29192-2 as a whole, modes of operation or the whole library.
